title: offline-bootstrap: OCI index + terraform mirror module for air-gapped registry bootstrapping
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private in fully air-gapped datacenters requested a more deterministic bootstrap flow for registries and OS images. Current airgap bundles are large and monolithic which makes incremental updates and signature verification awkward during upgrades. This PR introduces a compact OCI image index format for runtime bundles, and a Terraform module to provision a local mirror + registry-signing step in offline environments. Changes include: 1) a new 'oci-index' manifest generator that emits per-arch component descriptors (runtime images, charts, kernel modules) and an LRU-aware delta manifest pointer for efficient staged upgrades; 2) a Terraform module redwood-terraform/registry-mirror which wires up a local registry, preloads index manifests, and produces a signed admission config used by the installer; 3) Helm chart hooks to verify image signatures using cosign during pre-install, and a lightweight pre-pull controller that validates manifests against the pinned index; 4) installer upgrade/rollback flow updates: atomic manifest pinning with symlinked index bundles and a fast rollback hook that swaps pointer files and triggers a controlled reconcile. This description includes implementation notes, test plan, and rollout strategy. Implementation notes: the oci-index generator is written in Go and produces index.json alongside OCI blobs; each entry includes a semantic component tag (eg runtime:v1.42.0) and a digest pin. The Terraform module supports grabbing index artifacts from an offline bundle, uploading to a local registry, and producing a signed keypair bundle (KMS compatible) for the installer to verify at runtime. The Helm hook runs as a pre-install Job that verifies signatures and pre-pulls images into node-local cache. Testing: unit tests added for index generator, integration tests for the Terraform module using localbin (kind + registry) in CI, and an optional e2e nightly airgapped pipeline that exercises upgrade/rollback. Rollout: feature gated behind installer flag --offline-oci-index and disabled by default; will be exposed to customers as experimental for two releases. Checklist: - [x] OCI index generator (Go) - [x] Terraform registry-mirror module - [x] Helm pre-install signature verification hook - [x] Installer manifest pin/rollback hooks - [x] Unit/integration tests - [x] Docs and upgrade notes Backwards compatibility: existing monolithic bundles are still supported by the installer; when --offline-oci-index is not enabled, bootstrapping behaves exactly as before. Security: cosign is used to verify images; private key material is expected to live in customer KMS and is never uploaded to Redwood systems. Related: Linear ENG-3942 (airgap registry UX), ENG-4037 (upgrade safety).
commits:
1) Add oci-index generator and unit tests (A. Chen)
2) Add terraform/registry-mirror module and docs (A. Chen)
3) Add helm pre-install cosign hook and pre-pull controller (D. Martinez)

release_notes: Introduce experimental OCI index based offline bundles and a Terraform registry-mirror module to streamline air-gapped bootstrapping and staged upgrades. Disabled by default behind --offline-oci-index flag.
review_comments:
Diego Martinez: Nice work on the index format — can we include a small TTL field per component to help garbage collection?
Ava Chen: Added ttl_seconds to descriptors and documented GC behavior in docs/airgap/oci-index.md.
Riya Patel: CI flaked on the integration job the first run (registry timing). Added retries and a wait-for-registry helper to the test harness.
Owen Walker: Suggest adding a document describing key rotation for signed indexes.
Ava Chen: Added a key rotation subsection and example scripts.
Reviewers approved after two iterations.
notes_on_testing:
Unit tests: ./cmd/oci-index tests cover manifest generation and digest pinning.
Integration: terraform apply against local registry (kind) in CI; cosign verification end-to-end in an ephemeral cluster.
E2E: nightly pipeline (optional) performs full bootstrap from oci-index bundle and simulates upgrade + rollback.
upgrade_plan: Ship as experimental in v1.17. Customers opt-in via installer flag. First release will include migration docs for maintainers who want to convert monolithic bundles to OCI index bundles using provided tooling. After stable signal (2 releases, positive customer feedback) flip default to enabled and deprecate monolithic path with a 6-month warning.
security_considerations: Private keys are KMS-managed and only referenced during offline signing; cosign public keys are bundled with the index but validator code verifies trust chain. Installer refuses to boot when signature verification fails. All network touches are local to the customer's network during bootstrap.
observability_changes: Added metrics: installer.offline.index_verification_duration_ms, installer.offline.prepull_images_count, registry_mirror.upload_size_bytes. Dashboards updated in docs/dashboards/offline-index.md.
notes: This is intentionally conservative in behavioral changes: existing customers are unaffected unless they opt-in. The design aims to reduce bundle churn and to allow small delta updates in highly regulated offline environments.
